title: CHAPTER 043 - Serializer-safe queue repair and launch 031-040
description: Full automated repair. Uses serializer-safe task JSON, proves HOLD 019a SUCCESS, reads prior queue logs, backs up state/controllers, retires stale controllers, installs queue-controller-v3, validates syntax/process, and after 043 finalizes promotes prebuilt tasks 031-040 one by one after each predecessor reaches terminal state. Approval remains per chapter.
backup:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = 'C:/3EN-Agent'
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$bk = "$root/backups/043/$stamp"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk | Out-Null
foreach ($name in @(
    '3en-agent.state.json',
    '3en-agent.log',
    'queue-controller.ps1',
    'queue-controller.log',
    'queue-controller-v2.ps1',
    'queue-controller-v2.log',
    'queue-controller-v3.ps1',
    'queue-controller-v3.log'
)) {
    $src = "$root/$name"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination "$bk/$name" -Force
    }
}
Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT=' + $bk)
Write-Host 'CHAPTER_043_BACKUP=PASS'
